title: Microsoft's latest email outage turned into a full blown global cloud crisis | TechCrunch
summary: Microsoft is slowly recovering from its day-long outage after much of the company’s systems were hit by a cascading software issue. The last major incident affecting Microsoft services was in September , when a days-long outage hit Microsoft’s cloud services.
